authors_reviews.title: One “treat” to prevent pesky pests and keep pup happy
authors_reviews.text: I am thrilled with NexGard Plus! Instead of having to give my dog two not so tasty treats, he only needs one!Why did I give this 5 stars if my dog doesn’t enjoy them? It’s a monthly medication that covers him for fleas, ticks, and heart worm (and whatever else it does). It’s quick and easy for normal dogs…but my dog is spoiled and needs it wrapped in cheese, prosciutto, or other tasty snack before he will stop acting like a dainty prince and take the thing!It’s works fantastically, I still recommend it for picky dogs since it is effective…and my vet approves, so…there ya go!
authors_reviews.author: Kelly
